game.title: Topai Drana
game.description: A lively horseback game where riders chase each other to snatch a traditional cap (topai) from an opponent and place it on their own head, showcasing equestrian skill and agility.
howToPlay: Step 1: Riders gather on a field, with one rider designated as the target wearing a distinctive cap.
Step 2: On signal, other riders chase the target rider across the field.
Step 3: The chaser must catch up and snatch the cap from the target's head without dismounting.
Step 4: Once the cap is stolen, the new wearer must evade other riders trying to take it.
Step 5: Riders use precise horsemanship to maneuver close to opponents.
Step 6: The game continues until a rider holds the cap for a predetermined time.
Step 7: Falling off the horse or dropping the cap results in temporary disqualification.
Step 8: Skilled riders perform daring maneuvers to protect or steal the cap.
Step 9: The winner is celebrated with prizes and recognition.
Step 10: Matches are accompanied by traditional music and cheering crowds.
